response: In patients with myelomeningocele, untethering of the spinal cord is often necessary prior to scoliosis correction. This is because the tethered cord can cause further neurological deterioration during the correction surgery, and untethering can help prevent this complication. Additionally, a tethered cord can also affect the outcome of the scoliosis correction surgery. Therefore, many surgeons recommend untethering the spinal cord before proceeding with scoliosis correction to minimize the risk of neurological damage and optimize the surgical outcome.
